name: nd-rating-sync
description: Reads embedded rating tags from MP3, FLAC, Ogg-Vorbis, Opus, WAV, DSF, M4A/AAC and WMA files (ID3v2 TXXX FMPS_Rating / POPM iTunes / POPM WMP / TXXX:RATING; Vorbis comments FMPS_RATING / RATING; MP4 freeform atoms; ASF Extended Content Description Object) and syncs them to Navidrome's user ratings via the Subsonic API, with per-user per-library tag priority and overwrite control.
author: e1025735

library.reason: Read music files from all assigned Navidrome libraries to extract embedded rating tags

subsonicapi.reason: Call setRating to write star ratings back into Navidrome per user

users.reason: Required by the subsonicapi permission for per-user authorisation and to scope scrobble/scan events

scheduler.reason: Schedule periodic scans of the music library

kvstore.reason: Persist the last successful scan timestamp per (library, user) so recurring scans can skip files whose mtime has not changed since

sync_schedule.title: Sync schedule (cron expression)
sync_schedule.description: Cron expression for automatic recurring scans. Examples: '0 * * * *' = every hour, '0 2 * * *' = daily at 02:00. Changes take effect after the plugin is reloaded.

incremental_sync.title: Incremental sync
incremental_sync.description: When enabled (default), each (library, user) pair stores the timestamp of its last successful scan and skips songs whose file mtime predates it. Drastically reduces work on recurring runs after the first pass. Disable to force a full scan every run — useful for debugging or after changing a user's ratingTagOrder.

dry_run.title: Dry run
dry_run.description: When true, the plugin executes the full scan pipeline (fetch songs, read files, parse tags, apply all skip logic) but does not call setRating. Every rating that would be written or cleared is logged with a [DRY RUN] prefix instead. The incremental-sync threshold is not updated, so the next real run will re-process the same files. Useful for verifying tag parsing before the first import. Default: false.

default_skip_already_rated.title: Default: skip already-rated songs
default_skip_already_rated.description: Admin-level default for the per-user 'skip_already_rated' flag. Applied when a user entry leaves that field as Inherit. 'No admin default' here means the plugin uses true.

default_clear_rating_if_untagged.title: Default: clear rating if no tag found
default_clear_rating_if_untagged.description: Admin-level default for the per-user 'clear_rating_if_untagged' flag. Applied when a user entry leaves that field as Inherit. 'No admin default' here means the plugin uses false.

libraries.title: Library configurations
libraries.description: One entry per Navidrome library. Each entry defines which users are active in that library and their personal rating tag preferences.

libraryId.title: Library ID
libraryId.description: The Navidrome internal ID of the library (visible in the Libraries admin page).

libraryName.title: Library display name
libraryName.description: Human-readable label for your reference only — not used by the plugin at runtime.

users.title: User settings for this library
users.description: One entry per user whose ratings should be processed in this library.

username.title: Navidrome username
username.description: Must match the Navidrome username exactly. Also add this user to 'User Access' in the plugin permissions panel.

skip_already_rated.title: Skip already-rated songs
skip_already_rated.description: When Yes, songs that already have a star rating in Navidrome for this user are left untouched. Set to No to allow tag values to overwrite existing ratings. Inherit = use default_skip_already_rated; if that is also unset, the plugin uses true.

clear_rating_if_untagged.title: Clear rating if no tag found
clear_rating_if_untagged.description: When Yes, songs that have no embedded rating tag will have their Navidrome rating set to 0 (removed). To also clear ratings on songs that were previously rated in Navidrome, set skip_already_rated to No — otherwise already-rated songs are skipped before the file is read and their ratings will not be cleared. Inherit = use default_clear_rating_if_untagged; if that is also unset, the plugin uses false.

ratingTagOrder.title: Rating tag priority order
ratingTagOrder.description: Ordered list of embedded tag formats to try when reading a rating from a file. The first tag found in a file wins. Remove formats this user does not use. Supported values: WMP = Windows Media Player (POPM in MP3/WAV/DSF; WM/SharedUserRating in WMA), iTunes (POPM in MP3/WAV/DSF; lowercase 'rating' atom in M4A/AAC), MediaMonkey (FMPS_Rating TXXX in MP3/WAV/DSF; FMPS_RATING Vorbis comment in FLAC/Ogg/Opus; FMPS_Rating atom in M4A/AAC; FMPS_Rating Unicode string in WMA), foobar2000 (RATING TXXX in MP3/WAV/DSF; RATING Vorbis comment in FLAC/Ogg/Opus; uppercase RATING atom in M4A/AAC). Sources with no representation in a given container are silently skipped.
